question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH driver_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        d.driver_id,
        d.full_name,
        ds.points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY ds.points DESC) as rank
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN drivers_ext d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        c.constructor_id,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        cs.points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.year ORDER BY cs.points DESC) as rank
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
)
SELECT 
    dp.year,
    dp.full_name as top_driver,
    cp.constructor_name as top_constructor
FROM driver_points dp
JOIN constructor_points cp ON dp.year = cp.year
WHERE dp.rank = 1 AND cp.rank = 1
ORDER BY dp.year
